title: docs(spec): describe the shared-chunk bundle layout in three source comments
body:
Fixes #25811

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

Three source comments in `@objectstack/spec` still described the per-entry, self-contained bundle layout that the one-module-graph build replaced. They now describe the shared-chunk layout stated in `packages/spec/README.md` (Export surfaces) and the `oneModuleGraph` docblock in `packages/spec/tsup.config.ts`: a module two entries reach ships once, in a shared chunk, and an entry links every chunk its own module graph touches.

- `packages/spec/src/index.ts`: the standing-principle paragraph no longer says "self-contained bundle"; it keeps the cost rule and dates the +60.1 KB `/shared` measurement to the former per-entry bundles.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts`: only the `@__PURE__` note (the sentence that cited `splitting: false`). The PURE-annotation reasoning is unchanged and still holds per chunk.
- `packages/spec/src/api/package-api-assembled.zod.ts`: the module TSDoc.
- `content/docs/references/api/package-api-assembled.mdx`: regenerated with the spec package's `gen:docs` script, never hand-edited; the diff is the same sentence, two lines.

Landing point matches the claimed file surface exactly; the real producer of all four lines was in those files (measured on origin/main, `grep` for the three stale phrases found them only there).

## Not changed

No code, key, export or behaviour. Hunks elsewhere in `registry.ts` belong to other in-flight cards and were not touched.

## Changeset rule

A changeset is included (`patch`, `@objectstack/spec`). The os-dev fast lane lists comments as not publishing, but the measured criterion is what `files[]` ships: after a build, the new sentences are present in `packages/spec/dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/api-assembled/index.d.ts` (TSDoc rides in the declaration files), so the published content moved and `skip-changeset` does not apply.

## Verification

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` exit 0, then `gen:docs` exit 0: 229 files generated, exactly one tracked file changed.
- Local gate list from `dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` (108 families): 105 run, all exit 0. Three are NOT MEASURED, reason: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, they read built dist of packages this card does not touch), `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallowed clone. CI runs the full farm.

## Acceptance notes

The branch is `claude/project-thread-mybepv`, a platform-assigned branch (this session can push only that one), not the usual issue-named branch.
